title: Concrete transfer through the clopen proper graph
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, q:W→V proper, v:V→Y etale, f=qv, and c=(i:W→Z,g:Z→Y) a compactification. Put P=Z×_Y V with projections b:P→Z and p:P→V and t=(i,q):W→P. Construct t and prove tb=i and tp=q. It is open, by formal unramifiedness of b and openness of i, and proper, since p is separated and tp=q is proper. Its closed range makes the canonical inclusion t!→t* invertible. Define J_t:Rt*≅Dt! by right-deriving this sheaf isomorphism and using exactness of t!. Prove its unit normalization on every homotopy object. Define H_c:D(i*)≅D(b*)D(t*) by inverse-image composition. For K∈D(W_et,A), define T_K:Rq*K→Rp*Db*Di!K by inverse proper composition Rq*→Rp*Rt*, followed by Rp* of J_t and the t!⊣t* adjunct of η_i,K followed by H_c at Di!K. No compact-support compositor occurs. For finite A, exact proper base change Dv*Rg*→Rp*Db* is invertible.

proof.text: The pullback lift has the two stated projection identities. Apply the postcomposition criterion for open immersions to b and properness cancellation to p. Closedness of the range identifies extension by zero and direct image.

Right-derive the inverse clopen inclusion and use the exact comparison. Naturality of right derivation and the exact comparison unit equation prove graphDerivedIso_unit. Factor Rq* through Rt* and Rp*, then apply the graph adjunct of the open unit.
Proper base change is invertible for finite coefficients; transport between left-derived and exact inverse image identifies it with exactDerivedBaseChangeMap.
